source_snapshot.test_name: Single Device Multi-bit Correctable ECC Error
source_snapshot.test_set: Intel GNR CPU RAS - Single Device Data Correction (SDDC)
source_snapshot.purpose_facts: In Intel GNR 128b ECC mode, use CScripts to inject and consume one correctable multi-bit pattern confined to DQ1 of DRAM device 1 at socket0/channel0/dimm0/rank0/sub-channel0/bank-group0/bank0, then correlate IMC, retry-read and logical-rank corrected-counter evidence.
procedure_facts: Apply reference CScripts, error-reporting/firmware-first and optional OS prerequisites; prefer a POR population and disable Enforce Population POR only for an approved non-POR recipe.
Within CScripts, halt the target, require no pre-existing memory errors, prove 128b ECC mode and unlock injectors if approved.
Inject one `ce` at the exact source coordinates.

Require IMC correctable demand-read status `uc=0`, `mscod=0x80`, correlate retry-read set 1 address/parity with the target/mask, and require the selected logical-rank corrected counter to increment by one.
criteria_facts: Error logs match the injected condition.
source_conflicts: The criteria say only that logs should match, while the Procedure contains much stronger required correlations whose exact expected field values are delegated to an unavailable processor register specification.
The source says set 1 is a demand/ufill retry-log set based on a particular `en_patspr` output, but does not define what to do if runtime set selection differs.
The reference list permits an optional `ras=cec_disable` change and a non-POR exception without specifying when they are necessary or how to restore them.
missing_source_information: Versioned Intel/ODM recipe and register specification for the exact GNR stepping/harness/BIOS.
Physical DIMM DRAM x4/x8/device/DQ mapping proving the 0x2222... mask stays within one device and remains correctable in the observed ECC mode.
Exact logical-rank counter index for {DIMM 0, rank 0, sub-channel 0}, baseline and threshold.
Expected `en_patspr` mapping and full IMC/retry address/misc/parity field values.
Minimal BIOS/GRUB changes, log-baseline/clear policy, post-`go()` health, timeout, recovery and restoration.

original_test_intent.statement: Demonstrate Intel GNR single-device data correction by injecting one approved multi-bit pattern within a single DRAM device in confirmed 128b ECC mode and proving that the target IMC records a correctable demand-read event, retry-read logs identify the injected location/mask, and the exact logical-rank corrected counter increments once before normal execution resumes.
must_preserve: Intel GNR and exact DRAM x4/x8/ECC/topology dependencies.
128b ECC mode and source condition that directory mode/metadata-consuming features are disabled as required.
The exact source device masks and injection coordinates unless an owner formally revises the recipe.
IMC `uc=0`, `mscod=0x80`, retry-read address/parity correlation and exact logical-rank counter +1.
One injection followed by CScripts `go()` and 30/30-minute planning estimates.
must_not_infer: That the 0x2222... mask is correctable for an unverified x4/x8/device mapping.
That generic dmesg/SEL keywords prove SDDC or the target coordinates.
That `halt()` or `go()` are Linux host commands.
That retry-log set 1 remains correct if `en_patspr` differs from the signed recipe.
That successful injection alone is PASS or that PFD fields are required when the source calls them uninformative in 128b single-device correction.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly replaces DeepSeek's dmesg/SEL-only shortcut with the exact ECC mode, mask, coordinates, IMC status, retry-read correlation and corrected-counter evidence and keeps missing tooling as a package/confirmation prerequisite rather than permanent BLOCKED.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 hardens set-1 checking without saying that runtime `en_patspr` must first match the signed set selection; it also leaves `halt()`/`go()` control-plane ambiguity and the exact logical-rank counter index/restoration matrix implicit.

related_records: Other memory injections cannot supply this case's device/DQ mask, exact coordinates, 128b ECC assumptions or retry-log set mapping.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The detailed source sequence defines the intent and evidence. V2's technical expansion is retained where it makes source steps auditable, but no missing register decode, topology or counter mapping is guessed from neighboring Intel RAS cases.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep the approval-gated classification and exact single-device CE flow. V3 requires the runtime retry-log selection and logical-rank counter index to match the signed recipe before injection, confines `halt()`/`go()` to CScripts, and makes complete setting/log restoration part of completion.

conditions_present: ECC mode, example device/DQ mask, exact injection coordinates, intended severity/consumption, primary IMC decode, retry-log families, counter delta and target resume are present.
missing: Signed silicon/harness recipe, DRAM-device topology/mask proof, full register decode, retry-log selection, counter index/threshold, minimal settings, expected logs, timeout and recovery.
provider: Intel FAE/ODM memory-RAS owner supplies the versioned recipe, register decode, mask/topology and logical-rank mapping.
BIOS owner supplies exact prerequisite and restore matrix, including any non-POR/GRUB exception.
Lab/test owner supplies dedicated SUT approval, serial/OOB recovery, evidence and disposition rules.
safe_read_only_work: Record CPU stepping, BIOS/BMC/OS/kernel/harness and complete DIMM SPD/topology identity.
Capture current ECC mode, POR state, BIOS/GRUB settings, IMC/retry/counter registers, SEL/serial/OS logs and platform health without clearing or injecting.
Offline-compare the target/mask, retry-log selection, logical-rank index and expected field matrix with the signed recipe.
prohibited_until_resolved: BIOS/GRUB changes, harness halt, injector unlock, memDevs programming, fault injection, log clearing, resume/reset, retries or PASS.
closure_evidence: The signed recipe proves 128b ECC, DRAM x4/x8/device/DQ mapping, mask correctability and exact target coordinates.
Runtime `en_patspr`, selected retry-log set and logical-rank counter index/threshold match the expected matrix at baseline.
Minimal setting/log policy, one-shot approval, post-health, recovery and exact restoration are ready.

revision_candidate.test_name: Validate Intel GNR Single-Device Multi-Bit Correctable ECC Handling
revision_candidate.purpose: Inject and consume exactly one approved multi-bit pattern within one mapped DRAM device on Intel GNR in confirmed 128b ECC mode, then prove correctable demand-read handling through the target IMC status, matching retry-read location/parity records and a one-count increment in the exact logical-rank corrected-error counter without any uncorrectable or unrelated fault.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Only the GNR stepping, DIMM population, x4/x8 DRAM organization, 128b ECC mode, BIOS/EDKII build and CScripts harness in the signed recipe. Commands execute in the CScripts target-control environment; OS/BMC logs are supporting channels, not substitutes for register evidence.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One source-defined socket0/channel0/dimm0/rank0/sub-channel0/bank-group0/bank0/sub-rank0/ps_ch0 target, DRAM device 1 DQ1 mask `0x2222222222222222`, dev1 mask zero and one `errType=ce` injection. It excludes other DIMMs/ranks/devices, alternate masks, performance/stress and repeated injections. Treat 30/30 minutes as estimates.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: CPU/board/BIOS/BMC/OS/harness identities; signed Intel/ODM SDDC recipe and register spec; complete DIMM/SPD x4/x8/device/DQ and socket/channel/DIMM/rank/sub-channel map; proof of 128b ECC and feature settings; approved mask/coordinates; expected IMC status/address/misc fields; expected `en_patspr` and demand/ufill retry-log set; full retry address/misc/parity decode; exact logical-rank counter index/baseline/threshold; minimal BIOS/GRUB and original/restore matrix; baseline-log preservation/clear rule; serial/OOB access; one-shot approval; timeout, recovery and evidence storage.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve identities, settings, logs and full baseline registers/counters before any approved clearing. Apply only the signed prerequisite delta. In CScripts, call target-control `halt()` once, run `error.check_mem_errors()` and stop unless clean, prove `ras.mem.show_ecc_mode()` is the signed 128b mode, and unlock injectors only as approved. Verify runtime `en_patspr`, demand-log set and exact logical-rank counter index match the recipe. Program exactly `ei.mem.memDevs(dev0=1, dev0msk=0x2222222222222222, dev1=2, dev1msk=0x0)` and execute the single source `injectMemError(...)` coordinate/CE call. Capture full IMC status/address/misc, selected set-1 retry logs/address/misc/parity and the exact counter/threshold; stop rather than select another set if runtime mapping differs. Require `uc=0`, `mscod=0x80`, target/mask correlation and counter delta +1, then call harness `go()` once, verify health/log severity and restore all settings/injector state.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Dedicated non-production SUT; exact stepping/firmware/harness/DIMM topology match; POR population unless a signed non-POR exception exists; 128b ECC and compatible metadata/directory settings; clean memory-error baseline; expected retry set and counter index confirmed; stable power; serial/OOB recovery active; no production workload or competing injection; evidence capture and one-shot approval ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Platform/harness/recipe identities; DIMM SPD and physical-to-logical map; x4/x8/device/DQ proof; before/applied/restored BIOS/GRUB settings; clean memory-error baseline; 128b ECC output; injector-lock transcript; exact masks/coordinates and injection result; full baseline/post IMC status/address/misc; `uc=0` and `mscod=0x80`; baseline `en_patspr` with signed demand-set selection; raw and decoded retry-log set-1 address1/2/3, misc and parity matching target/mask; exact logical-rank counter baseline/post delta +1 and threshold; `go()` transcript; serial/OS/EDAC/SEL evidence with no UE/fatal/unrelated error; final memory/BMC/OS health and settings restoration; engineer disposition.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The signed Intel/ODM GNR 128b-ECC SDDC recipe and register specification. Pass requires one attributable CE injection, correct target/mask, clean baseline, correctable IMC demand-read decode, signed retry-set/location/parity correlation, exact logical-rank counter +1 below the disallowed threshold, no unexpected UE/fatal condition, successful resume/health and complete restoration. Injector success or generic CE logs alone are insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not run on production; treat harness `halt()`/`go()` as OS commands; assume mask correctability from frequency of success; use an unverified x4/x8/topology; disable POR or CEC outside the signed exception; clear logs before preserving them; unlock/program/inject against dirty baseline; choose a different retry set when `en_patspr` mismatches; alter coordinates/masks; repeat automatically; exceed threshold; or leave DFX/error-injection/GRUB/BIOS state changed. Stop on any mismatch, UE/fatal event, hang/crash or lost recovery channel.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Intel/ODM memory-RAS owner approves topology, mask, target, decodes, retry set and counter; BIOS owner approves settings and restoration; lab owner approves the disruptive one-shot test/recovery; a human authorizes halt/unlock/injection immediately before execution and judges PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED or any reset/retry.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: FAE/engineers provide protected harness/specs and validate topology, mapping, masks and settings; humans authorize fault injection and handle exceptional recovery. An Agent may drive the exact approved sequence and compare registers/logs after handoff but may not invent decodes, switch log sets, self-authorize or retry.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On dirty baseline, wrong ECC/mapping, unexpected severity, decode/counter mismatch, hang or crash, stop further injection, preserve raw harness/register/serial/OS/SEL evidence and use only the signed OOB/firmware recovery. Restore injector locks and every BIOS/GRUB/debug/error-logging change, then prove memory, BMC and OS health. No rerun without owner review and fresh approval.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Recipe/spec, topology/mask, 128b ECC, target, expected retry-set/counter mapping, settings/restore, approval, timeout or recovery is missing; baseline memory errors exist; runtime `en_patspr` or counter index differs; injection result or IMC status is unexpected; `uc` is not 0 or `mscod` is not 0x80; address/parity does not match; counter delta is not exactly +1 or violates threshold; any UE/fatal/unrelated error, hang/crash or health loss occurs; `go()` fails; or settings cannot be restored.

identified_defects: The source criteria are too vague for the detailed required register correlations.
The mask's single-device/correctable meaning depends on unprovided x4/x8/device/DQ topology.
V2 does not stop on runtime `en_patspr` disagreement before hardcoded set-1 evidence.
The exact DDR5 logical-rank counter index is missing.
Harness halt/go and optional non-POR/CEC settings need explicit control-plane/restoration boundaries.
reason_for_change: Retain the source's unusually complete SDDC flow while closing the remaining runtime selection, topology, counter-index and cleanup gaps that could otherwise produce a correct-looking but misattributed CE result.

new_technical_evidence.title: Error Detection And Correction (EDAC) Devices
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Supporting OS evidence after the platform-specific Intel injection
new_technical_evidence.supports: Linux EDAC distinguishes corrected, uncorrected and fatal memory events and represents x4/x8 device types, supporting an explicit no-UE/fatal health gate and topology-aware evidence rather than a generic `ecc` grep.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: EDAC does not define the Intel private harness, mask, IMC/retry registers or logical-rank mapping.

new_technical_evidence.title: Reliability, Availability and Serviceability (RAS)
new_technical_evidence.supports: Correctable and uncorrectable memory errors are distinct harvested events; a CE can allow continued operation, but OS reporting remains supporting evidence and does not replace controller attribution.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Expected OS event format and firmware-first visibility are platform-specific.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-System RAS-00127-V002
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Only this Intel GNR SDDC case
new_technical_evidence.supports: The exact ECC mode, device masks, coordinates, IMC decode, retry-log sequence, counter +1 requirement and target resume.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Private register decodes, topology mapping, runtime set selection and restoration are not fully specified.

removed_ambiguities: Defines halt/go as CScripts target control.
Requires the mask to be proven against the installed x4/x8/device/DQ topology.
Makes retry-log set 1 conditional on matching the signed `en_patspr` map and stops on mismatch.
Requires the exact DDR5 logical-rank counter index rather than an unspecified counter.
Separates private controller attribution from supporting OS/SEL evidence.
resolved_blockers: Missing CScripts and private register data are provider-closable package/spec inputs, not evidence that the test is inherently non-automatable.
remaining_blockers: Execution awaits the signed recipe/spec, topology/mask proof, retry-set/counter map, settings/restoration, approval and recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 prevents a hardcoded retry-log set or wrong rank counter from falsely matching a CE, explicitly binds the mask to the installed DRAM organization, and makes one-shot resume plus complete settings restoration part of completion.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The contract-only validator preserved one CScripts halt/injection/go sequence, exact coordinates, topology-dependent mask, runtime retry-set gate, logical-rank counter +1 and full restoration. It rejected generic CE/counter-only completion, treated zero-masked dev1 as non-injected, and left API device naming and physical DQ mapping to the signed platform handoff.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Reliability row 170 injects one CE at socket0/channel0/dimm0/rank0/sub-channel0/bank-group0/bank0 using the DQ1/device1 0x2222... mask in 128b ECC and requires IMC, retry-log and exact rank-counter evidence.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 restores most missing evidence but hardcodes set 1 without an explicit stop on `en_patspr` disagreement and leaves logical-rank indexing and harness control/restoration implicit.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow complete read-only topology/settings/register/counter baselines; permit one exact injection only after the private recipe proves mask, set and counter mapping and recovery/restoration are approved.
